avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: May induce metabolism of DM1 payload; potential reduced efficacy of cytotoxic component
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; consider alternative herbal products if needed

avoid_supplements.name: High-dose Vitamin E (>400 IU daily)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: May potentiate bleeding risk and increase cardiotoxicity concerns with ADC therapy
avoid_supplements.action: Limit vitamin E supplementation; discuss with oncology team

caution_supplements.name: Ginseng
caution_supplements.mechanism: Potential immunomodulatory effects may interact with antibody-mediated immune response
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for altered treatment response; use with caution

caution_supplements.name: Echinacea
caution_supplements.mechanism: May theoretically impact immune function during HER2-targeted therapy
caution_supplements.action: Use judiciously; inform oncology team of use

avoid_foods.name: Grapefruit/Grapefruit juice
avoid_foods.mechanism: May inhibit metabolism of DM1 linker, increasing cytotoxic exposure and cardiotoxicity risk
avoid_foods.action: Avoid grapefruit and grapefruit juice during treatment course

caution_foods.name: Alcohol (>2 drinks/day)
caution_foods.mechanism: Additive cardiotoxicity risk with ado-trastuzumab; increased hepatic stress
caution_foods.action: Limit alcohol consumption; discuss safe limits with care team

caution_foods.name: High sodium foods
caution_foods.mechanism: May exacerbate potential cardiac dysfunction from HER2 inhibition
caution_foods.action: Maintain moderate sodium intake; monitor fluid retention

monitoring_notes: Ado-trastuzumab is an antibody-drug conjugate with limited hepatic metabolism; monitor for cardiac toxicity (LVEF) and infusion reactions. Coordinate dietary and supplement modifications with oncology team, especially regarding cardiotoxicity risk factors.
